question: Why did reported revenue change yesterday?

findings.proposal: Review duplicate order IDs against the source; do not delete automatically.

trace.sql: SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM orders GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE amount IS NULL
SELECT MAX(day) AS latest_day FROM orders
SELECT day, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

limitation: Checks identify contract violations, not definitive root cause. A revenue decline can be genuine; reconcile business context. Proposals never execute writes.
